info.name: Tenge Tracker API (JWT)
info.description: HW4 collection: signup/login with JWT, public vs protected endpoints, full CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), ownership checks (403) and validation errors. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner after `docker compose up --build`. Tokens and IDs are stored in collection variables automatically; the collection-level auth sends `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

exec: // Dates used in request bodies: always the current month

item.name: 0. Public endpoints & 401 without token
GET me with a forged token (401)

item.description: Public GETs work without a token. Every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE and all personal data return 401 without a valid token.

item.name: 1. Auth (signup, login, me)
item.description: Signup and login return { accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, user }. The token is saved to {{token}} and used by the collection-level Bearer auth.

item.name: 8. Ownership: other user's data (403)
Demo user does not see my accounts

exec: pm.test('Demo has its own 5 seeded accounts', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().every(a => a.userId === 1)).to.be.true);

item.description: Authenticated is not the same as authorized: the API checks that the resource belongs to the user in the token.
